description: Start a job to lip-sync an owned portrait to owned audio. First call chargen_quote_portrait_audio, confirm the price with the user, then supply its quote_token with identical inputs. Spends the quoted Gold; returns request_id to poll with chargen_get_job. Only the declared settings are supported. An identical call within about 10 minutes returns the earlier request instead of charging again; pass a new idempotency_key when the user wants another take with the same settings.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio supported by the model, such as 16:9.

audio_id.description: Owned gallery audio UUID to lip-sync.

duration_seconds.description: Video duration in seconds, where supported by the model.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (letters, numbers, - and _). Reusing it returns the same request without a new charge; a new key makes a new take with the same settings.

model.description: Enabled video model supporting portrait-audio; chargen_list_media_models can help choose a model. This never changes the operation.

prompt.description: Optional: a short note on what should be seen.

quote_token.description: Approved quote_token from chargen_quote_portrait_audio. Use the same inputs; changed inputs or prices fail without charging.

resolution.description: Resolution supported by the model, such as 720p.

source_image_id.description: Owned still image to animate or use as the portrait.

name: chargen_generate_portrait_audio
title: Start portrait audio
